title: Mainsah et al. 2025 — bigP3BCI: An Open, Diverse and Machine Learning Ready P300-based Brain-Computer Interface Dataset (Study R)
description: This dataset is Study R of bigP3BCI, an open P300-based brain-computer interface collection. It contains 32-channel EEG recorded at 256 Hz from 20 participants with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) over two sessions each, using 9x8 multi-face speller grid paradigms with target and non-target flash events. It is a BIDS-formatted derivative of the PhysioNet bigP3BCI release, converted with MOABB (Mother of All BCI Benchmarks) 1.5.0, and is suited to machine learning and BCI speller research. Note: the source README's 'Health status: healthy' field is an automated default and conflicts with the study description of ALS participants.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a g.USBamp (g.tec) amplifier using 32 channels in a standard 10-20 montage at 256 Hz. Participants used a P300 speller with a 9x8 character grid and multi-face stimuli, with online feedback in a laboratory setting. Events are labeled Target and NonTarget with HED annotations, and epochs span 0 to 1.0 s after stimulus onset.
